description: Four units whose lossless channel set has one channel and the channel mask bit 31, which Table 6-22 reserves.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder names no speaker for the bit, so ffprobe finds no channel and the decoder fails
skip.ffprobe_channels: ffprobe finds 0 channels for a reserved bit: the lossless layer gives no channel layout
